lines.latin: str. A. Manoilov (Moldovan Cyrillic: A. Manoilov Street)

notes: Trilingual stencilled street plate in Tiraspol (Transnistria): Moldovan/Romanian in Cyrillic, Russian, Ukrainian, all Cyrillic; house number 34 on an oval tile above. Abbreviations are lower case, names upper case. The bronze memorial plaque at the top ('...КАВБРИГАДЫ / Г.И. КОТОВСКОГО') is cut off and a distractor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Three languages in one street sign, Tiraspol, Transnistria.jpg

author: Julian Nyča

author: Gikü
attribution: Photo: Gikü, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MD.C.S%C3%AEngera_-_welcome_sign_to_Chi%C8%99in%C4%83u_municipality_-_oct_2026.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Concrete welcome lettering at the Chișinău municipality boundary on the R2, viewed at an angle; the dots of the i's are spheres. The Ș has a detached slanted block below (comma form) and the Ă a block breve on top, so OCR may drop the diacritics. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Gikü
attribution: Photo: Gikü, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MD.ST.Lozova_-_Codru_scientific_reserve_(street_sign)_-_may_2017_-_47.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted arrow-shaped road sign to the Codrii nature reserve beside the M1 near Lozova; Ț has a mark below, 'CODRII' is in Romanian low-high quotation marks and its two I's carry small hat marks (stylised, not diacritics). The white board at the left with animal drawings and a tiny 'CODRII' logo is a distractor.
source_title: File:MD.ST.Lozova - Codru scientific reserve (street sign) - may 2017 - 47.jpg

author: photobankmd
attribution: Photo: photobankmd, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Entrance_sign,_Floresti,Moldova.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Mosaic-tile town entrance stele of Florești with a sunflower motif and founding year 1588. No comma under the S is visible (the ledge below may hide it), so the line is transcribed without it; the place is Florești. Small 'photobank.md' credit at the bottom-right edge, not across the image. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
